3. Sushrusha

Initially for the first 20 minutes the salesman at the counter was roaming around here and there.

When I asked to hurry up, He asked me where did I stay with a strange look.

Dude know your customers first. I have been turning up at your store since the last 25 years.

If you cant recognize your daily customers what kind of business are you looking doing.

Let me remind you that yours is a medical shop. Dispensing medicine fast as per the doctors prescription is your duty to your customers.

The salesman that I encountered was trying to be a doctor himself.

When I lost my patience and raised my voice the salesman came in his senses and gave me the medicines in just 3 seconds.

Sincere request to Swami Samarth Management .......get rid of such jerks from the counter.

Daadhiwala
